anchors.derivation: B. Georgiev, J. Gomez-Serrano, T. Tao, A. Z. Wagner, "Mathematical exploration and discovery at scale," arXiv:2511.02864, Section 3 ("Difference bases"): AlphaEvolve improved the published upper bound on C = inf_n Delta(n)^2/n from 2.6571 to 2.6390 -- the first improvement since the bound's prior published value. Independently corroborated via web search (author list, venue, and the 67-problem catalogue this paper reports on) on 2026-09-06.
